snippet.title: CLUTCH Developer DIary - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061930/CLUTCH/

Maverick Games Creative Director Mike Brown gave us a closer look at the studio's cinematic open-world driving game, CLUTCH, where you tear up the French Riviera. It's coming to PC & Consoles in Spring 2027.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
